# Vellum Institute

Vellum Institute is a small, application-based online institute. High school students take live seminars with university faculty and experienced industry professionals affiliated with premier universities, then may continue with optional one-on-one guided research or apprenticeship.

Seminars are eight weekly, ninety-minute live sessions, capped at fifteen students, and end in a substantive original project. Students apply; they are not simply enrolled. Public seminar tuition is by inquiry and is shared directly once a student is matched to a cohort.

Inaugural cohort: Spring 2027 (February–April). Later summer and fall cohorts are planned.

Website: https://velluminstitute.org/

## For counselors

College counselors and advisors can complete a short gated survey and receive The Hidden Rules of College handbook: https://velluminstitute.org/counselors/
